items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sweet Hands is a real record date in the studio, Abercrombie, Charlie Haden.

ctx.x: How would you compare that to the Sweet Hands date?

No, Sweet Hands is a real record date in the studio, Abercrombie, Charlie Haden. That’s a real record date. This is like an Indian – put-together, just because we were in India. We were the first jazz group in India in 20 years, since Benny Goodman. Something like that. It was quite something, the trip to India. It was really amazing. Of course it was amazing.

There’s a variety of things with – at least the Forgotten Fantasies date we talked about. Then there’s the Lookout Farm date that Mosaic Select put out in recent years, that was done in San Francisco.
